adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed as `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`, which requires the user to be both admin and owner. The subsequent permission gate `if (!isTeamAdminOrOwner && !isOrganizer && !isAttendee)` will therefore reject a team admin who is not also the team owner (and not organizer/attendee) with `FORBIDDEN`. This is consistent with the finding and is verifiable in the diff; the UI also adds the “additional_guests” action in `BookingListItem.tsx` without any role check, making the mismatch user-visible.
